name: French Shapes From libpostal's Fixtures
description: The seven French fixtures of libpostal's test_parser.c (MIT licence), each written again as an original input of the same shape: the same parts, order and punctuation, another commune. A commune alone is not an address, and reads as none. Each case's source names the fixture it follows.

libpostal's French fixtures.name: a commune with an accent
libpostal's French fixtures.description: libpostal 'Chambéry' (a commune alone, with an accent): a name alone is not an address
libpostal's French fixtures.source: Original case written for this corpus in the shape of libpostal's test_parser.c (MIT) fixture test_fr_parses (a commune alone, accented): the same parts, order and punctuation, another place; nothing copied
